```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(scales)
library(splines)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
```

## 1. Data Processing

```{r}
# Load raw data
df <- read.csv("raw_data.csv")
nrow(df)
```

```{r}
# Variables whose previous-match values we want to retain
prev_vars <- c(
  "nominal_minutes_played",
  "total_distance_m",
  "zone1_distance_m",
  "zone2_distance_m",
  "zone3_distance_m",
  "zone4_distance_m",
  "zone5_distance_m",
  "top_speed_kmh"
)

# Add previous-match information
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert match_date to Date
    match_date = as.Date(match_date)
  ) %>%
  
  # Put each player's appearances in chronological order
  arrange(
    tournament_year,
    player_tournament_id,
    match_date,
    fifa_match_number
  ) %>%

  # Previous matches must be computed separately within each tournament/player
  group_by(tournament_year, player_tournament_id) %>%

  mutate(
    # Match metadata from previous appearance
    prev_match_id = lag(match_id),
    prev_match_date = lag(match_date),

    # Days since previous appearance
    recovery_days = as.integer(match_date - prev_match_date),

    # Previous-match physical statistics
    across(
      all_of(prev_vars),
      lag,
      .names = "prev_{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%

  ungroup()
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  # Filter out rows where player played less than 10 minutes
  filter(
    !(is.na(nominal_minutes_played) | nominal_minutes_played < 10)
  ) %>%
  
  # Normalize distance statistics by minutes played
  mutate(
    normalized_total_distance_m = total_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
    normalized_zone1_distance_m = zone1_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
    normalized_zone2_distance_m = zone2_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
    normalized_zone3_distance_m = zone3_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
    normalized_zone4_distance_m = zone4_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
    normalized_zone5_distance_m = zone5_distance_m / nominal_minutes_played,
  )

nrow(df)
```

## 2. Data Visualization

```{r}
# Running Rate Distribution by Position
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = position,
    fill = position
  )) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.15) +
  labs(
    title = "Running Rate Distribution by Position",
    x = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    y = "Density",
    color = "Position",
    fill = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}
pairs.panels(df[, c(
  "prev_nominal_minutes_played",
  "prev_total_distance_m",
  "recovery_days",
  "nominal_minutes_played",
  "normalized_total_distance_m"
)], gap = 0, pch = ".")
```

```{r}
# Running Rate vs. Minutes Played by Position
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = nominal_minutes_played,
    y = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = position
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Running Rate vs. Minutes Played by Position",
    x = "Minutes played",
    y = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    color = "Position"
  )
```

```{r}
# Ignore GK and combine all other positions, facet by minutes played bins (adjust bins)

# Running Rate vs. Recovery Days by Position and Minutes Played
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(recovery_days)) %>%
  filter(recovery_days < 15) %>%
  mutate(
    minutes_bin = cut(
      nominal_minutes_played,
      breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90, Inf),
      labels = c("≤30", "31–60", "61–90", ">90")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = recovery_days,
    y = normalized_total_distance_m,
    color = minutes_bin
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~position) +
  labs(
    title = "Running Rate vs. Recovery Days by Position and Minutes Played",
    x = "Recovery days",
    y = "Running rate (meters per minute)",
    color = "Minutes played"
  )
```

```{r}
# Don't mean center recover days

# Within-Player Running Rate vs. Recovery Days
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(recovery_days)) %>%
  group_by(player_tournament_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  mutate(
    recovery_dev = recovery_days,
    running_rate_dev = normalized_total_distance_m - mean(normalized_total_distance_m)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    minutes_bin = cut(
      nominal_minutes_played,
      breaks = c(0, 30, 60, 90, Inf),
      labels = c("≤30", "31–60", "61–90", ">90")
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = recovery_dev,
    y = running_rate_dev,
    color = minutes_bin
  )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~position) +
  labs(
    title = "Within-Player Running Rate vs. Recovery Days",
    x = "Recovery days relative to player average",
    y = "Running rate relative to player average (m/min)",
    color = "Minutes played"
  )
```

```{r}
# Within-Player Running Rate vs. Previous-Match Distance
df %>%
  filter(!is.na(prev_total_distance_m)) %>%

  facet_wrap(~position) +

    title = "Within-Player Running Rate vs. Previous-Match Distance",
    x = "Previous-match distance relative to player average (m)",
```

## 3. Modeling

```{r}
# Ignore rows corresponding to first game at the tournament for a player (missing previous game data)
df_filtered <- df %>% filter(!is.na(recovery_days))
```


```{r}
# normalized_total_distance_m ~ 1 + recovery_days + position
fit1 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position,
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit1)
```

```{r}
# Fix position and recovery days and plot fitted values to see spline curve

# Add ns(nominal_minutes_played, df=4)
fit2 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             ns(nominal_minutes_played, df=4),
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit2)
```

```{r}
# Add prev_total_distance_m
fit3 <- lm(normalized_total_distance_m ~
             recovery_days +
             position +
             prev_total_distance_m +
             ns(nominal_minutes_played, df=4),
           data = df_filtered)
summary(fit3)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(team_tournament_id)
fit4 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(nominal_minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id),
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit4)
```

```{r}
# Add random_effect(player_tournament_id)
fit5 <- lmer(normalized_total_distance_m ~
               recovery_days +
               position +
               prev_total_distance_m +
               ns(nominal_minutes_played, df=4) +
               (1 | team_tournament_id) +
               (1 | player_tournament_id),
             data = df_filtered)
summary(fit5)
```
